messages:
leah: Quick UX thread: users reported confusion when selecting rows in eval runs then using the top bulk actions. The selection badge reads '3 selected' but the bulk action menu shows 'Apply to all' which made someone think it would apply to the entire run not just the selection. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/select-2265.png

maya: yeah that's ambiguous. We should make the menu context-aware: if there's an active selection show 'Apply to selection (3)'; otherwise 'Apply to all runs'.

leah: agreed. I prototyped a small inline label near the menu that updates live: "Selection: 3/24" so users see both the selected count and total. Thoughts on copy?

samir: 'Apply to selection (3)' is concise and clear. For the inline summary maybe '3 selected of 24' is fine. Implementation note: keep the selection aria-live region polite so screen readers hear updates when selection changes.

rong: accessibility nit: selection keyboard flow. When users Shift+Arrow to select multiple rows, focus currently jumps unpredictably. Focus should remain on the row where selection started and only move when explicit Tab/Arrow interactions happen. Also announce selection counts via aria-live.

nina: microcopy: for the bulk action menu the 'Approve' option currently says 'Approve' only. Suggest 'Approve selected tests' or 'Approve selected runs' depending on context. Keep verbs explicit.

leah: good call. Another edgecase: when users have a filter applied, 'Apply to all' sometimes is ambiguous—does it mean all visible (filtered) or all runs? We need to disambiguate: show 'Apply to filtered (12)' vs 'Apply to entire run (24)'.

maya: UI idea: in the menu show a small subline under each action: e.g., 'Approve selected runs
applies to 3 selected' vs 'Approve visible runs
applies to 12 shown'. Keep subline smaller and subdued. Ensure contrast passes.

samir: dev note: calculating counts for 'visible runs' is cheap client-side. For 'entire run' (server scope) we might need a backend call. Show a loading state like 'Apply to entire run (computing...)' and disable until count resolves. Announce status updates to assistive tech with aria-live assertive for long-running computations.

rong: keyboard accessibility: menu items must be reachable via Arrow keys and Enter triggers action. If an action opens a confirmation modal, initial focus should move to modal title and we should ensure Escape closes modal and returns focus to the original menu anchor.

leah: modal copy suggestion for bulk approve: title 'Approve selected runs?' body 'This will mark 3 selected runs as Approved. This action is versioned and logged. Are you sure?' primary 'Approve 3 runs' secondary 'Cancel'. If action affects filtered/entire run show counts accordingly.

nina: for mixed-state selections (some passing, some failing) default button should be 'Approve passing runs (2)'; show secondary 'Force approve all (3)' behind a danger modal that requires justification. This is consistent with other flows.

maya: microcopy for toast after bulk action: current 'Approved' is too terse. Change to 'Approved 3 runs — view audit (undo)' and include the audit id (e.g., a789) in accessible label: 'Approved 3 runs, audit a789'. Undo should be keyboard-focusable and open a revert modal.

samir: implementation detail: when building undo, create a parent audit event referencing child changes. Undo endpoint should accept parent id and only allow revert within a configurable time window (default 5min). We'll surface the window in tooltip.

rong: a11y check: ensure the aria-live for the toast uses polite unless it's an error. The undo button inside toast must be reachable by Tab (not only by mouse). Also provide `aria-label` on the toast that includes the action summary and audit id.

leah: small mobile note: bulk menu collapses into an overflow, so we need to preserve the 'selection summary' in the overflow header. On tiny widths show '3/24 selected' instead of the full text.

nina: polish: if the selection is empty, hide the bulk menu but show a small hint: 'Select runs to enable bulk actions' with a learn-more link to docs. Make the hint keyboard-focusable.

maya: UX decision: should Shift+Click extend selection on touch? probably not. For touch show long-press to enter selection mode, then tap to toggle rows. Announce 'Selection mode' when activated.

samir: dev note: implement isTouch detection and fallback to long-press. Keep accessibility semantics the same (aria-pressed on row toggles).

designbot: Accessibility advisory: contrast check for the inline summary text is 3.6:1 1 borderline. Recommend using `neutral-800` token for the small text. Also ensure hit target for small icons >=44px.

leah: great feedback  i'll update the figma: new menu labels, selection summary badge, modal copy, toast copy with audit id, mobile selection behavior, keyboard flow notes, and aria-live strategies. Will push frames and a short prototype link. Please drop any alternative copy suggestions by EOD. :eyes:
